# team

The people who belong to a tenant, the roles they hold, and the invitations still open.

## GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/invitations

Operation `tenant_invitation_list`.

Invitations the tenant has outstanding, oldest first.

|---|---|---|---|---|

Responses:

## POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/invitations

Operation `tenant_invitation_create`.

Invite an address to the tenant. The address receives a link that lets it choose a password and join with `roles`. An address that already has an account, or an open invitation, is a 409.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenant_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [TenantInvitationCreate](schemas.md#tenantinvitationcreate)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [TenantInvitationView](schemas.md#tenantinvitationview)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/invitations/{invitation_id}

Operation `tenant_invitation_revoke`.
